classification.source_level_rationale: points to other records: This unit functions as a repertory/index within the Swiss Federal Archives, organizing historical publications and diplomatic records.
classification.resume: The record is a finding aid entry describing historical publications transmitted to the Swiss Federal Archives, specifically a historical treatise on Swiss regiments and documentation of the Swiss delegation to the Peace Congress of Münster and Osnabrück. It indexes archival materials rather than being the primary historical document itself. The entry is part of a repertory of the Swiss Representation in Paris covering the period 1798–1939.
